title: NNTP ARTICLE response: synthesize X-Usenet-IPFS-Verified header
description:
On ARTICLE/HEAD commands, query verification results and prepend a synthetic header.

What: crates/reader/src/session/ (wherever ARTICLE/HEAD response is assembled)

Header format:
  X-Usenet-IPFS-Verified: usenet-ipfs-sig=pass; dkim=pass domain=example.com selector=s1

Rules:
- If multiple DKIM signatures: repeat dkim= token for each.
- If result is no-key: omit that check entirely (header only present if at least one check ran).
- If no verifications recorded for this CID: omit header entirely.
- Header is synthesized at read time from SQLite — never stored in article bytes (would change CID).

Algorithm:
1. After fetching article bytes by CID, call store.get_verifications(&cid).
2. If empty: skip header.
3. Format as single-line header value; prepend to response headers.
4. verify_store is optional (None → never emit header).

Defensive rules:
- SQLite query failure: log warn, omit header, do not fail the ARTICLE command.
- Header value must contain no newlines (sanitize detail fields before interpolation).
